title: The Recipe Step You Skipped
youtube_title: The Recipe Step You Skipped | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Pema is tangled up with a recipe step you skipped and hoped no one would taste and almost hides it. Pema tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
